mapper.update: update photoinfo set photo_url=#{photoUrl}, tag_id=#{tagId}, file_path=#{filePath}, fingerprint=#{fingerprint}, title=#{title} where id = #{id}
update photoinfo set photo_url=#{photoUrl}, tag_id=#{tagId}, user_id=#{userId}, fingerprint=#{fingerprint}, title=#{title} where file_path = #{filePath}
mapper.select:
SELECT t1.id, t1.photo_url AS photoUrl, t1.tag_id AS tagId, t1.dateTime, t1.user_id AS userId, t1.file_path AS filePath, t1.fingerprint, t1.title, t2.name AS tagTitle, COUNT(DISTINCT t3.id) AS collectTotal, COUNT( DISTINCT t4.id) AS likeTotal, t5.name as userName, t5.userimageurl FROM photoinfo t1 JOIN tag t2 ON t1.tag_id = t2.id LEFT JOIN usercollection t3 ON t1.id = t3.photo_id LEFT JOIN liketable t4 ON t1.id = t4.photo_id LEFT JOIN userinfo t5 ON t1.user_id = t5.id
AND t1.tag_id = #{tagId}
AND t1.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
GROUP BY t1.id, t1.photo_url, t1.tag_id, t1.dateTime, t1.user_id, t1.file_path, t1.fingerprint, t1.title, t2.name
ORDER BY t1.dateTime DESC
ORDER BY t1.dateTime ASC
ORDER BY collectTotal DESC
ORDER BY collectTotal ASC
ORDER BY likeTotal DESC
ORDER BY likeTotal ASC
mapper.insert: insert into photoinfo(photo_url, tag_id, dateTime, user_id, file_path, fingerprint, title) values (#{photoUrl}, #{tagId}, #{dateTime}, #{userId}, #{filePath}, #{fingerprint}, #{title})
mapper.delete: delete from photoinfo where file_path = #{filePath} and tag_id = -1
